messages:
micah: Heads up, after last-night's IdP cert rotation we started getting SCIM 400s and some users lost roles. Provisioning endpoint returned malformed attribute payloads.
tara: saw the pager. can you dump a redacted assertion sample?
micah: pasted redacted snippet from proxy logs:
```
<Attribute Name="email">=�A@example.com</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="groups">[�]Engineering;Platform</Attribute>
```
looks like embedded nulls and odd control chars in attributes.
aisha: ugh. that will break our group->role mapping. did okta change anything on their side besides cert rotate?
micah: Okta shows only a cert rotation. deploy-bot: identity-proxy v2.14 deployed 2026-03-20T03:12Z. suspecting proxy double-decode / charset mismatch.
sre-oncall: checked KMS and envelope logs  nothing suspicious; assertion arrived base64 but proxy decoded to bytes with UTF-16 indicators. we normally expect UTF-8.
tara: any recent changes to XML parsing libs or middleware that touch encoding?
devops: we bumped libxml2 on canary yesterday (tiny patch). i can reproduce locally by taking a utf-8 assertion, encoding it to utf-16le, base64ing twice; proxy that decodes once hands utf-16 bytes to parser which treats as utf-8 -> nulls appear.
micah: repro steps (local):
1) take assertion xml (utf-8)
2) convert bytes to utf-16le
3) base64 -> wrap as SAML body
4) proxy decodes only once, feeds parser expecting utf-8
result: attributes get � bytes, group string truncated, SCIM fails with 400 and roles are dropped.
aisha: that explains the RBAC fallout. any short-term mitigation?
tara: immediate mitigations proposed:
- add charset autodetect & transcode in identity-proxy (detect BOM or heuristic, transcode to utf-8)
- add assertion header validation to reject/alert when charset!=utf-8 (and coordinate with IdP to fix)
- rollback libxml2 bump on canary if it looks causal
sre-oncall: putting a temporary WAF rule to detect embedded nulls in SAML payloads and convert failures into alerts instead of silent drops.
micah: i'll open a PR to identity-proxy to do defensive transcode + extra logging + metric. tagging @aisha for RBAC reconciliation once logs exist.
aisha: will run a role-reconcile/backfill after the fix. need assertion->group parsing logs (last 6h).
devops: patch pushed to staging; canary rollout in 10m.
micah: canary live; initial telemetry shows 70% reduction in 400s. monitoring for 30m then request prod deploy.
devops: prod rollout scheduled in +1h unless we see regression.
aisha: also want structured audit flag for malformed assertions on provisioning events: e.g. "malformed_assertion": "true" and include attr-hash for downstream triage.
tara: yes, add a short-term retention for those audit records (14d) and export to sec-analytics for correlation with support tickets.
sre-oncall: confirmed KMS not involved; key id and envelope look normal. keeping KMS out of scope for now.
micah: follow-up action items:
- micah: PR for identity-proxy charset-detect + tests
- devops: prod rollout + rollback plan
- aisha: RBAC reconcile & audit entries + user count report
- tara: postmortem doc (root cause: charset mismatch caused by double-encoding interplay between IdP and proxy; mitigation & long term fix)
closing: will update thread with reconcile numbers. :thumbsup:
